maddeler.e:
نتعالم (form VI)
# نَتَعَالَمُ (nataʕālamu) /na.ta.ʕaː.la.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَعَالَمَ (taʕālama)
# نَتَعَالَمَ (nataʕālama) /na.ta.ʕaː.la.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَعَالَمَ (taʕālama)
# نَتَعَالَمْ (nataʕālam) /na.ta.ʕaː.lam/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَعَالَمَ (taʕālama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
